Wobnimo 0.2.0 engine (`dist/index.js`), copied unchanged from the official `wobnimo` npm package. It draws Hyzer the Disc, the Atlas Coach's mascot.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/wobnimo/v/0.2.0
File SHA-256: `b5284b26482c50171f8a14dbdb00e4217330b2225d65ee817458de764e9ff8e9`
License: MIT, Pourya Akhbari (`wobnimo/LICENSE.txt`)

Self-contained, no dependencies and no network calls. Only the engine is included: no built-in characters, web component or React wrapper. It loads only when the coach panel opens.
